decision: The actual fixed non-CM E_l and every quadratic twist satisfy the required rational G_Qab unipotent and cyclotomic absolute-irreducibility hypotheses.

nine_obligations.name: source_hypotheses
nine_obligations.required: An elliptic curve over a number field, geometrically without complex multiplication, and its genuine Tate representation.
nine_obligations.constructed: The fixed E_l over Q has l positive squarefree, l congruent to 11 modulo 12, and equation y²=x(x−l)(x+3l).
nine_obligations.why_match: The three roots are distinct. c4=208l² and Delta=2304l⁶ give j=35152/9, a noninteger rational number. The classical integrality of CM j-invariants excludes geometric CM.

nine_obligations.name: constructed_objects
nine_obligations.required: The same lattice and rational representation later consumed by Kato.
nine_obligations.constructed: T=T_2(E_l), V=T tensor Q_2, and Vχ for the actual quadratic characters χ=χ0(x composed with ψ).
nine_obligations.why_match: No projective representation, auxiliary modular curve, or CM index-generator curve is substituted. E_l is fixed before any family of conductor primes.

nine_obligations.name: domain_index_coverage
nine_obligations.required: All quadratic characters in the finite character family, and coefficient prime 2, with constants independent of varying conductor support.
nine_obligations.constructed: A single principal congruence subgroup for fixed E_l produces one subgroup of rho(G_Qab); every quadratic χ is trivial on G_Qab.
nine_obligations.why_match: The same subgroup works simultaneously for every χ, irrespective of conductor. The open-image statement includes the prime 2. The bound may depend on E_l and is not uniform in l.

nine_obligations.name: transition_comparison_maps
nine_obligations.required: Pass from the full G_Q Tate image to the abelian-kernel image and then to the cyclotomic restriction.
nine_obligations.constructed: Lift explicit matrix commutators to G_Q. Their lifts lie in G_Qab. G_Qab is contained in G_Q(mu_2∞), and twisting is unchanged on it.
nine_obligations.why_match: Upper and lower unipotents are obtained by actual commutators, not from an unsupported inference that a cyclotomic unipotent lies in G_Qab. An explicit Gauss decomposition proves an open SL2 subgroup.

nine_obligations.name: identity_of_consumed_object
nine_obligations.required: A unipotent on this Vχ with one-dimensional fixed space, belonging to G_Qab, plus absolute irreducibility on the cyclotomic subgroup.
nine_obligations.constructed: U(b) and L(c), b and c nonzero, act on the same Vχ.
nine_obligations.why_match: U(b) has fixed line Q_2 e1; L(c) has fixed line Q_2 e2. These remain distinct over an algebraic closure. This proves Kato 0.6(ii), and excludes invariant lines on the cyclotomic restriction.

nine_obligations.name: coefficients_normalizations
nine_obligations.required: Rational p-adic conditions, with the Tate representation convention and abelian inverse-deck coefficients preserved.
nine_obligations.constructed: The argument is over Q_2 on T_2E tensor Q_2. Every abelian coefficient action is trivial on G_Qab.
nine_obligations.why_match: Nonzero b,c are units over Q_2 and over any Q_2 coefficient algebra; both fixed-vector equations force zero. The argument does not require scalar specialization to have finite order, and does not alter Frobenius or purity conventions.

nine_obligations.name: local_conditions
nine_obligations.required: Preserve the character family’s stated real sign and local squareclasses at primes dividing 2N.
nine_obligations.constructed: The original character family remains unchanged. The image argument holds for every quadratic character without imposing further conductor, real, or local constraints.
nine_obligations.why_match: A stronger global subgroup argument validates the existing local family. It does not construct that family or prove purity, oddness, or its Selmer local conditions.

nine_obligations.name: exceptional_cases
nine_obligations.required: Address rational full 2-torsion, the prime 2, and the distinction between rational and strong integral Kato hypotheses.
nine_obligations.constructed: E_l has full rational 2-torsion, so its mod-2 image is trivial, but its 2-adic image is open. The characteristic-zero nonidentity unipotent suffices away from 2.
nine_obligations.why_match: No residual irreducibility or surjectivity is assumed. If b is divisible by 2, the cokernel of 1−U(b) on the lattice has torsion; the proof therefore does not claim condition (ii_str). The separate CM generator curve is not in scope.

nine_obligations.name: downstream_consumption
nine_obligations.required: The exact rational irreducibility/unipotent hypotheses used by Kato 1999 Theorem 0.8 and the displayed K15 application.
nine_obligations.constructed: V13 explicitly uses 0.6(ii) in G_Qab, identifies the retained class and its coordinate ideal, and works at height-one primes away from 2.
nine_obligations.why_match: This review discharges the non-CM/open-image/twist subgroup input and its fixed-vector consequence. It does not reaccept the separate index, norm, class, local-complex, nonvanishing, RC, or literal-318 assembly obligations.
